items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(f) allows one travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice; vehicle costs are a standard, indemnified ancillary charge for necessary repair visits. Reference cases (e.g., 62, 65) and price priors show t per unit about 83.
Sealing material is a necessary consumable for pipe repair, covered under 7.1.7(c). Reference cases (39, 55) and price priors show t per pc about 25.

items.description: Premium large-diameter stainless steel pipe (upgraded from the original narrower-bore installation)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.9: indemnity is limited to the cost of a standard-grade, original-bore equivalent; the upgrade to premium/wider pipe is excluded betterment. Reference cases (39, 55) show standard stainless pipe t per m about 42–54.

items.description: Designer gunmetal fittings (higher specification than the original)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.9: indemnity is limited to standard-grade fittings, not designer upgrades. Reference cases (39, 43, 44, 56) show standard fittings (e.g., Profipress elbows, grub screws) t per 2 pcs about 9–51.

items.description: Premium aluminium-clad insulation (upgraded from standard rock wool)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.9: indemnity is limited to the cost of standard rock wool insulation, not premium upgrades. Reference cases (39, 44, 56) show standard rock wool insulation t per m about 20–33.

Installation is only indemnified for the work needed to restore to pre-loss standard, not for upgraded work. Reference case 55 (bathroom pipe repair) shows t per hr 86–135; here, 1 m of pipework is likely 1–2 hrs, so use upper end for a complex job.

Labour for necessary repair is covered under 7.1.7(g), but only for the time reasonably required to restore to pre-loss standard. Reference case 55 (9 units) t >= 765; price prior per 9 units about 834.
Drying is necessary preparatory work under 7.1.7(b), indemnified once per drying operation. Reference cases (39, 51, 55) and price prior show t per unit about 595.

items.description: Painting the disturbed wall area and closing the wall opening
items.rationale: Restoration of the disturbed area is covered under 7.1.7(a) and (c), but only for the affected patch, not the whole wall. Reference cases (39, 51, 55) and price prior show t per pc about 647.
